notes.text: Our revenues vary from year to year primarily as a result of changes in realized commodity prices and production volumes. For the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, our oil and natural gas sales increased 50% and 22%, respectively, from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025, excluding the effect of settled commodity derivatives, primarily driven by higher oil prices. Production volumes increased approximately 3% for the three months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the same quarter in 2025 and approximately 2% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the same period in 2025.

analysis: Revenue was $7.5M in H1 2026, down 18% year over year.

Operating costs exceeded revenue by $7.5M, an operating margin of -100.3%. Total costs grew 58% against revenue growth of -18%. The fastest-growing cost line was Other operating costs (+74%). The period ended with a net loss of $6.5M.
